title: Van Reede's code passages to the Hereditary Prince and Princess Wilhelmina, 1796-1807 (KHA A35-1232, A32-549)

steps.what: A35-1232 and A32-549 paired page by page (research/nationaal_archief/k89 pairing files): nine passages without decipherment.
Nine passages and four glossed control pages transcribed at full size (runs_a.txt, runs_b.txt).

reede1789 table and the 1795-96 Euler list tested on the 15 glossed control runs: R 3/13 own gloss vs 2/13 another; E 3/32 vs 0/32. Control values (91 Ivoy, 72 Duc, 13 Athlone, 6/52 Haugwitz) contradict both.
Colenbrander Gedenkstukken II and III full text: no Van Reede letter to the Erfprins printed.

Prince's six drafts opened (clear drafts of outgoing letters, no numbers); Van Reede's 'Explication des chiffres' on 144359 gives whole sentences for short runs of 144358 (seven groups for about 200 letters) and the letter names the 'Chiffre Litteral': the 1796 system is a book code keyed to an unnamed printed text.
Explication runs (4) 39.97.16 = 'de son voyage de Pyrmont' and (5) 29.17.19.37 = a 30-word sentence: each number is a whole phrase; a prepared phrase list, not a printed book; no book test possible.

outcome.method_basis: Neither known key of the correspondents fits the glossed controls; the codes of 1796 and 1797-1801 are not rebuildable from about 15 glossed values.

gaps.item: nine passages of A35-1232 and A32-549, about 580 groups
gaps.detail: 1796 passages: book code, book unknown; 1797-1801: larger list, too few glosses; neither known table fits

prior.where: Colenbrander Gedenkstukken II-III searched in full text: not printed

human: Lead chosen by the user from the KHA sweep; user asked to transcribe the nine passages and test the reede1789 table and the Euler list.
